explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1096 with the answer yes (Erdős–Komornik). There is ε > 0 such that for every 1 < q < 1+ε, the increasing enumeration x of {Σ_{i∈S} q^i : S finite} has x_{k+1} - x_k → 0. The universal quantification over strictly monotone x with range equal to the set is not vacuous: since q > 1, only finitely many sums lie below any bound, so the set is discrete and has a unique such enumeration starting at 0.
